subject: Contract closure playbook and kickoff window
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Jin <caroline@NimbusAnalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Draft MAP & signature timeline for pilot — proposed playbook

Caroline —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our agreement, attached is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation milestones, approval owners, and the signature timeline needed to get the pilot live. High-level ask: can you confirm procurement's preferred signing cadence so we can align DocuSign routing and the Redwood activation window?

Key dates proposed in the MAP (draft):
- Contract sign-off window: 11/16–11/18
- Tech kickoff (post-sign): 11/23 (one-week technical prep)
- Pilot start date: 11/30

I've flagged the main approval owners in the doc and included an expedited DocuSign flow for single-signer PO + CFO countersign if required. If Nimbus needs legal redline time, tell us the latest date you'd need to keep the kickoff on 11/30.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf (MAP + responsibilities)

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm procurement email/PO cadence and any internal blackout dates
2) We share the DocuSign package to the procurement contact for signature routing (we can pre-fill SOW items)
3) Redwood ops stands by for activation as soon as signatures clear

I'll loop in our legal ops if you expect redlines.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Caroline Jin <caroline@NimbusAnalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@NimbusAnalytics.com
Date: 2026-11-12T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & signature timeline for pilot — proposed playbook

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the MAP. This looks clean and helpful. A few quick notes from procurement and legal:

- Procurement prefers a single PO + signature from our Head of Procurement (PO issued same day as signature). We try to avoid multi-step countersigns when possible.
- Legal will likely request a minor clarification on data retention (section 4.2) — estimate 48–72 hours for a short redline.
- Can we shift the contract sign-off window one day later to 11/17–11/19? We have an internal finance freeze on 11/16.

If you can accept 11/17–11/19 for signatures, we can still make a technical kickoff by 11/24 and keep the pilot start near 12/1 (we need three business days to provision integrations after signature).

I'll attach the procurement PO template we use and loop procurement properly once legal confirms redlines.

Best,
Caroline
Director of Product, Nimbus Analytics

Attachment: Nimbus_PO_Template.pdf (procurement template)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Jin <caroline@NimbusAnalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T13:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & signature timeline for pilot — proposed playbook

Caroline —

Appreciate the heads up on the finance freeze. 11/17–11/19 works for us. I've looped Legal (Rishi) to stay on standby for any redlines; Rishi, the Nimbus legal team mentioned a short clarification on data retention in section 4.2 — they expect 48–72 hours. Can you confirm if that window would jeopardize the 12/1 pilot target if redlines occur on 11/17?

Marissa, Sergio — can you plan for a tentative tech kickoff on 11/24 and an activation window starting 12/1 (provisioning + integration days: 11/24–11/27)? If legal redlines require changes to SOW, we should prepare a fallback kickoff of 12/6.

I'll prepare the DocuSign package targeting Nimbus' Head of Procurement as single-signer and include the PO field per their template.

Thanks —
Naomi

> On 2026-11-12 11:05, Caroline Jin wrote:
> > Thanks for the MAP. This looks clean and helpful.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Caroline Jin <caroline@NimbusAnalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & signature timeline for pilot — proposed playbook

Hi all —

I reviewed the data retention clause Caroline referenced. Proposed language is a one-paragraph clarification that preserves Nimbus' requested retention period while keeping Redwood's standard audit log provisions intact. This is a minimal redline and should be quick.

If Nimbus turns around the redline on 11/17, we can complete review and routing by end of day 11/18. That keeps the DocuSign signature window of 11/17–11/19 realistic, and I don't expect it to push the activation beyond 12/1 assuming signatures are received by 11/19.

I'll add the proposed clause to the DocuSign package so legal accepts in-line edits. Laura — please confirm we can route the final SOW to operations for provisioning immediately after signature.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

> On 2026-11-12 13:18, Naomi Feldman wrote:
> > Appreciate the heads up on the finance freeze. 11/17–11/19 works for us.

From: Caroline Jin <caroline@NimbusAnalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@NimbusAnalytics.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & signature timeline for pilot — proposed playbook

Naomi / Rishi —

Good news: Procurement issued PO #57021 this morning and attached it to the DocuSign package. Legal accepted the brief retention language with your suggested wording. I signed as the business approver and routed to our Head of Procurement for final sign (single-signer route).

Attached: Nimbus_PO_57021.pdf (official PO). Please confirm Redwood has received the completed DocuSign envelope; procurement will release the PO to finance on signature which should clear our internal steps.

Request: we'd like a soft start date of 12/1 but keep the tech kickoff week as 11/24–11/27 for provisioning. If you can confirm activation/testing steps and a Redwood owner for the week of 11/24, we'll finalize schedules.

Thanks,
Caroline

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Jin <caroline@NimbusAnalytics.com>, procurement@NimbusAnalytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contract closure playbook and kickoff window — GO (signatures in)

Caroline —

Confirmed: DocuSign envelope received and completed (we have the signed PO). Thank you and procurement for the quick turnaround.

Final decisions and asks: 
- Status: SIGNED (PO #57021) — Redwoods ops will begin provisioning per the MAP.
- Tech kickoff (internal): 11/24 — Marissa Cole will be the Redwood lead for provisioning and integration.
- Soft pilot start: 12/1 — redemption of activation tasks and handover to Nimbus product team planned for 12/4 after initial run.

Marissa, please lead the kickoff and post a short RACI to the Nimbus shared drive by EOD 11/19. Laura, ops confirmed resource availability for 11/24–11/27. Sergio, I'll follow up on invoicing cadence and credit terms separately (finance).

Welcome aboard, Caroline — excited to get Nimbus live. I'll share the DocuSign envelope ID and final MAP PDF in a follow-up thread for your records.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
